key_visual_point: The new Teams plan grew from zero to 15,000 seats in two months, passing Enterprise
script:
The bar chart displays paid seats by plan from January to March 2025.
Pro seats started at 41,000 in January, increased to 43,000 in February, and reached 44,000 in March.
The Enterprise plan began with 2,000 seats in January, remained at 2,000 in February, and grew to 3,000 in March.
The Teams plan, launched in February, shows zero seats in January, then jumped to 6,000 seats in February and 15,000 seats in March.
This rapid growth made the Teams plan the second-largest plan by March.
Enterprise pilots are currently running in four regions.

slide_title: Where Lena's new customers come from
key_visual_point: Almost half of new customers found the bakery through Instagram posts
script: This pie chart shows where Lena's new customers came from between October 2024 and February 2025. The largest source of new customers, at 45%, came from Instagram posts, totaling 144 customers. Walk-ins accounted for 25%, word of mouth for 20%, and local flyers for 10%. Overall, 320 new customers were acquired during this period.

key_visual_point: Sales jumped about 50% when the catering menu launched in December and stayed at that higher level
script: This bar chart shows monthly sales in USD from September 2024 to February 2025. Sales jumped about 50% in December to $27.4k and remained at a higher level in January and February, reaching $30.3k by February. The slide title is "Monthly sales since September." Key points include the catering menu launch on December 2nd, with the same two staff and no paid advertising.
